When the sky splits open.
And listens to its Lord, as it must.
And when the earth is stretched out flat.
And throws out what is inside it and becomes empty.
And listens to its Lord, as it must.
O human, you are working hard toward your Lord, and you will meet Him.
The one who is given his record in his right hand.
Will have an easy account.
And will return to his family happy.
But the one who is given his record behind his back.
Will call out for destruction.
And will enter a blazing fire.
He used to be happy among his family.
He thought he would never return to Allah.
Yes, he will! His Lord was always watching him.
Allah swears by the red glow after sunset.
And by the night and everything it gathers.
And by the moon when it becomes full.
You will go from one stage to another stage.
So what is wrong with them that they do not believe?
And when the Quran is read to them, they do not bow down?
But those who reject keep on denying.
And Allah knows best what they hide in their hearts.
So give them the news of a painful punishment.
Except for those who believe and do good. They will have a reward that never ends.
